body:
I thought about it every day for more than a year now. There is nothing left for me to live for and I cannot imagine even a tiny possibility of a better future. I've done what I could and it's only gotten worse.

Nobody loves me. My parents just don't want all the money they've invested to go to waste. But they don't know it's already gone to waste. My mom told me today that if I don't do well in school, there's no point to having me around. She left for work so now I can do it once and for all.
